0x00056C:
A giant artificial hibernation facility built under Project Ark, the species preservation plan of the <EOT Special Council>. Located underground in Africa's Kenya district, it is run by Magus, an autonomous supercomputer created by Dr. Sophia Nate. Thousands were to sleep there through the coming Aerogater invasion, but the <DC War> halted its construction.
After the war, remnant DC forces made it their base until the Kurogane's crew wrecked it. It now falls under a special Federation research institute. A twin facility, the 'Moon Cradle,' exists on the Moon.
0x000938: A class of anti-alien mobile weapons evolved from fighter craft. The <Tesla Drive>, a reaction thruster separating gravitational and inertial mass, lets them fly unaided and outmaneuver any fighter. The DC's mainstay in the DC War, they are still built by <Isurugi Heavy Industries> for the Federation.
0x000B4E: Short for 'Identification Friend Foe,' a device that identifies units as friend or foe.
0x000BEE:
An isolated South Pacific island off the Marquesas, where the meteorite Meteor 3 fell in New Era 179. The <EOTI Organization> set up headquarters there to study it, and the <EOT> and anti-alien weapons research there became the power base of the <DC>.
The island was fortified in the name of <EOT> secrecy, its defenses built around air power. Largely destroyed fighting the Septuagint in the <L5 Campaign>, it was rebuilt by the GS as its home base, 'Grand Christmas.'
0x000F14:
Grotesque beings that appeared in the Earth Sphere in New Era 187-188. Their main force, the Einst series, were enigmatic living weapons that at first waged inexplicable localized battles. Only the high-ranking Einst Regisseur and a girl named Alfimi showed clear will and intellect; their society resembled that of bees or ants.
The Einst had long existed in another dimension (Einst space), seemingly watching the real world's intelligent life. To silence humanity, which fought endlessly and disturbed the universe's calm, and create a new intelligent species, they finally tried to join Einst space to the real world and invade it.
They fought the Hagane, Kurogane, and Hiryu Custom repeatedly. In the final battle Neu Regisseur fused with the White Star into the colossal Stern Neu Regisseur, but fell to the Kurogane and Hiryu Custom; the remaining Einst then vanished as well.
0x0014FD: A standard measure of the <Telekinesis Alpha Pulse>. Highly focused people tend to score high; past a set value, one possesses telekinesis. It also shows a subject's compatibility with the <T-LINK System>.
0x00168F: Short for Extra Over Technology - alien super-technology found in 'Meteor 3,' the meteorite that fell on Aidoneus Island. Analyzed by the <EOTI Organization> under Dr. Bian Zoldark, it revolutionized many fields, above all military technology, but its use was controlled by the <EOT Special Council> and saw almost no civilian application.
0x0018E9: Extra Over Technology Inquiry Organization. Founded in New Era 180 to analyze the <EOT> found in 'Meteor 3,' the mysterious meteorite that fell on Aidoneus Island. Brilliant scientists gathered from around the world under Bian Zoldark, hailed as the genius of his age. It became the parent body of the <DC>, where its scientists continued developing weapons and systems.
